symptoms: starter clicks but engine does not turn

hypotheses.name: weak_battery
hypotheses.diagnostic_step: With the key off, place a DC multimeter across the battery terminals (red to +, black to -). Then attempt to crank for 3-5 seconds while an assistant reads the meter.
hypotheses.expected_result: Resting voltage 12.4V or higher; voltage under crank stays above 9.6V. Anything below indicates a weak or discharged battery.
hypotheses.if_confirmed: Charge the battery for 4-6 hours at 10A or replace if it will not hold above 12.2V after charging. Clean and re-torque terminals to 6-8 Nm.
hypotheses.if_ruled_out: Battery is healthy. Move to starter_motor_failure hypothesis.

hypotheses.name: starter_motor_failure
hypotheses.diagnostic_step: With battery confirmed good, bridge the starter solenoid's small trigger terminal to the large battery-positive lug with an insulated screwdriver (engine in neutral, fuel off). Listen and observe.
hypotheses.expected_result: Starter should spin the engine vigorously. A single loud click with no rotation, or a grinding/whirring with no engagement, indicates solenoid or starter motor failure.
hypotheses.if_confirmed: Remove and bench-test the starter. Replace the starter motor or rebuild solenoid contacts. Inspect ring gear for missing teeth before reinstall.
hypotheses.if_ruled_out: Starter engages and spins freely. Move to fuel_starvation hypothesis.

hypotheses.name: fuel_starvation
hypotheses.diagnostic_step: Check fuel level in tank. Open the bleed screw on the secondary fuel filter housing and operate the hand primer pump 15-20 strokes. Observe fuel flow.
hypotheses.expected_result: Clean, bubble-free diesel should flow steadily from the bleed screw within 10-15 strokes. Air, foam, or no fuel indicates starvation (empty tank, clogged filter, air leak on suction side, or failed lift pump).
hypotheses.if_confirmed: Replace primary and secondary fuel filters. Inspect suction-side hoses and clamps for cracks. Bleed the injection system fully before re-cranking.
hypotheses.if_ruled_out: Fuel delivery is healthy. Escalate: check compression, glow plugs, and injection pump timing (defer to expert per DEFER path).
